export.data.notContainer: What comes before {field} is not a container
export.data.notObject: The element at {name} is not an object
export.data.notOne: {name} does not match exactly one element
export.data.pathNeeded: The path of a field or an element is needed

export.settings.fromGone: In export {export}, the from of row {row} (writing to {to}) is gone (a card or section that was removed)
export.settings.versionGone: In export {export}, the version in the from of row {row} (writing to {to}) is gone (a removed version of {card})
